note: Final is native 1920x1080 physical rendering, not enlarged 720p plates. 16 samples is the measured floor: against a 64-sample reference the error is a constant 0.38/255 outdoors and 0.65/255 indoors, varying by 0.002 across consecutive frames, and the two are indistinguishable at 1:1 on wet reflections, contact shadow, glass, DOF and motion blur.
